metadata.name: Computer Control
metadata.description: Computer Use: once authorized, the agent can see the screen, move the mouse, click, and type. Includes permission guidance, an emergency stop, and a full action audit; visual decisions go through the cloud model gateway of your signed-in account.

stop.hint: After stopping, all input is rejected immediately and held mouse buttons are released

permissions.title: System permissions
permissions.accessibility: Accessibility (required for mouse and keyboard input)
permissions.screen: Screen Recording (required for screenshots and the pointer guard; restart the app after granting)
permissions.queryFailed: Couldn't read the status. Click Refresh to try again.

console.title: Task console
console.intro: Describe a task in plain language, for example: open WeChat and send a message to File Transfer. Every step is visible and you can stop at any time.
console.placeholder: Describe what the agent should do…
console.egress: Once started, each step sends a screenshot and the task description to the cloud vision model. Don't use the mouse or keyboard while it runs, and keep anything you don't want sent off the screen.

result.fail: The model reported it could not finish
result.invalidReply: The model reply is not a valid action JSON
result.emptyReply: The cloud vision model returned no text

model.title: Vision model (via your account's cloud gateway)
model.intro: Screenshots and instructions go through the Host cloud channel (credentials belong to your account; no API key needed). The quality tier is recommended for visual targeting.
model.label: Model tier

trace.title: Action audit
trace.queryFailed: Couldn't read the status. Click Refresh to try again.

notice.detailsHint: Turn on Host developer mode to see the original error details

settings.versionLabel: View the release notes for version {version}
settings.changelogMissing: Release notes for this version ({version}) have not been published yet.
settings.changelogLanguageNote: The release notes are written in Chinese.
settings.aboutBlocked: Opening external pages from a plugin isn't supported yet. Copy the address and open it in your browser.

errors.homeMountFailed: Couldn't initialize the Computer Control home page
errors.bridgeMissing: Computer control bridge is not available (not in a plugin surface)
errors.aiBridgeMissing: Cloud AI bridge is not available (not in a plugin surface)

cause.permissionMissing: A system permission is missing. Grant it under System permissions, then try again.
cause.stopped: Computer control is emergency stopped. Click Resume control, then try again.
cause.rateLimited: Too many actions too quickly. The engine is rate limiting; try again shortly.
cause.targetRejected: The target is a protected window (a password manager or this app), so the action was refused.
cause.engineRejected: The engine refused this step. Check the screen and try again.
cause.model: The cloud vision model call failed. Make sure you are signed in to the app and try again.
cause.unknown: The action did not complete. Try again shortly.
